Verified summing the second-difference fractional Gaussian covariances gives (1-r)^2 Li_{-2H}(r)/r, and independent 1000-term high-precision covariance sums match the polylog. Jonquière expansion plus θ_h=1/2+cx yields relative variance (1-H)(1/6-2c)x² + ζ(-2H)x^{2H+1}/Γ(2H+1)+O_H(x^{2H+2}). c=1/12 uniquely kills x² within this family, with negative nonzero ζ(-2H) for H∈(1/2,1) giving sharp fractional rate. Padé denominator/numerator positivity gives 0<r<1 all x>0. Independent high-precision asymptotic checks H=0.6,0.8 corroborate only, not prove universal H.
